sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, rp.cnt AS replacementCount FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store OUTER APPLY (SELECT COUNT(lk.PimLinkProductDetailid) AS cnt FROM dbo.ZnodePimLinkProductDetail lk INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute la ON la.PimAttributeId = lk.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct rpp ON rpp.PimProductId = lk.PimProductId WHERE lk.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND la.AttributeCode = @linkCode AND rpp.IsActive = @isActive) rp WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND p.IsObsolete = @obsolete AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.PublishProductEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @obsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND (@minReplacements IS NULL OR rp.cnt >= @minReplacements) AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @zero AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) ORDER BY p.SKU
